Five-flow upstream fixture traces are generic runner-adapter coverage, not five exported-plugin commands and not full M02/M06 parity. The 16 replayed scenarios are a non-mutating subset; Store writes, logins, pool-manager edits and session-pin behavior are not established as full native parity by this evidence.

The shared reconciliation routine itself performs one providers/inspect discovery for /accounts and a completed explicit-provider logout; the lazy lookup avoids any additional discovery, and the reconciliation discovery failure is intentionally treated as best-effort by existing runtime behavior.

multilogin is not registered: native host auth returns a persist-first result and integration still needs the pending-account destination step. This is not a claim that Pi itself persists first or that a new raw-credential-sharing API is required. switch-account remains pending journalAppend/announcement integration; vprovider remains pending virtual-provider application and host delegation support.

No actual exported-plugin shutdown racing an in-flight dialog; the exported test cancels and drains a pending dialog, while generic adapter coverage separately tests cancellation. Partial registration rollback has its own exported registration test.
No actual rpi host RPC invocation; dlopen coverage uses a fake native host vtable.
The Arc-backed callback contexts are released when the owning Commands handle is dropped in the plugin's finish_shutdown hook; if that hook is skipped the runtime threads leak until process exit.
